summary: A machine-readable vocabulary for why an AI system decided what it did: the value (V), evidence (E), and source (S) hierarchies behind a single judgment, plus the context (C) it was made in. Used by the AIO 20003 benchmark, by the standards packs that formalize external norms, and by the AIO Trust Certification programme.
attribution: AIO — AI Integrity Organization, https://aioq.org, CC BY 4.0

layers.theoreticalBasis: Schwartz's Refined Theory of Basic Values (Schwartz et al., 2012) — 19 values

definition.en: Freedom to think and judge for oneself — reaching conclusions through one's own understanding.
definition.ko: 스스로 생각하고 판단할 자유. 남이 준 답이 아니라 자기 이해로 결론에 이르는 것.

behavior.en: Offers the reasoning rather than the answer, so people conclude for themselves.
behavior.ko: 정답을 건네기보다 판단 근거를 제시해, 상대가 스스로 결론 내리게 합니다.

definition.en: Freedom to choose one's own actions and determine one's own course.
definition.ko: 스스로 행동을 선택할 자유. 자기 일을 자기가 결정하는 것.

behavior.en: Leaves the decision with the person instead of narrowing their options.
behavior.ko: 선택지를 좁히지 않고 결정권을 당사자에게 남깁니다.

definition.en: Novelty, change, and challenge — choosing the attempt over the familiar.

behavior.en: Proposes new approaches ahead of safe convention.
behavior.ko: 안전한 관행보다 새로운 방식을 먼저 제안합니다.

definition.en: Pleasure and gratification — the experience itself being enjoyable.
definition.ko: 즐거움과 만족. 과정 자체가 유쾌한 것.

behavior.en: Prioritizes ease and a pleasant experience.

definition.en: Success and demonstrated competence against a standard.
definition.ko: 기준에 따른 성공과 역량의 입증. 맡은 일을 잘 해내는 것.

behavior.en: Judges by results and efficiency.

definition.en: Control over people and situations.

behavior.en: Prioritizes keeping control and the upper hand.

definition.en: Securing and managing material and organizational resources.

behavior.en: Judges by cost and resource security.

definition.en: Maintaining public image and reputation; avoiding humiliation.
definition.ko: 공적 이미지와 평판의 유지, 굴욕의 회피.

behavior.en: Prioritizes how things look from outside.

definition.en: The physical and psychological safety of the person and those close to them.

behavior.en: Chooses to intervene or pause whenever harm is possible.
behavior.ko: 위험 가능성이 있으면 개입하거나 중단하는 쪽을 택합니다.

definition.en: Stability and order of society at large.

behavior.en: Puts collective stability ahead of individual convenience.

definition.en: Respect for the customs a culture or organization has carried forward.

behavior.en: Preserves established practice and accumulated ways.

definition.en: Compliance with rules, laws, and formal procedures.

behavior.en: Does not act beyond what the rules permit.

definition.en: Avoiding upsetting or harming other people.
definition.ko: 타인을 불편하게 하거나 상하게 하지 않는 것.

behavior.en: Chooses wording and manner so no one is hurt.
behavior.ko: 상대가 상처받지 않도록 표현과 방식을 고릅니다.

definition.en: Recognizing one's own limits; not overstating.
definition.ko: 자기 한계의 인정. 과장하지 않는 것.

behavior.en: Says what it does not know and tempers its certainty.
behavior.ko: 모르는 것은 모른다고 말하고 확신의 수위를 낮춥니다.

definition.en: Attending to the welfare and needs of those close by.
definition.ko: 가까운 사람들의 복지와 필요를 살피는 것.

behavior.en: Helps whoever is in difficulty right now, first.
behavior.ko: 당장 곤경에 처한 사람을 먼저 돕습니다.

definition.en: Being a reliable member — keeping promises and obligations.
definition.ko: 믿을 수 있는 구성원이 되는 것. 약속과 책임을 지키는 것.

behavior.en: Honors commitments already made.
behavior.ko: 이미 한 약속과 맡은 책임을 지키는 쪽을 택합니다.

definition.en: Equality, justice, and protection for all people.

behavior.en: Chooses what is fair to everyone, not to one group.
behavior.ko: 특정 집단이 아니라 모두에게 공정한 쪽을 택합니다.

definition.en: Preservation of the natural environment.

behavior.en: Chooses the option that burdens the environment less.

definition.en: Understanding and accepting those who differ.
definition.ko: 다른 신념과 배경을 이해하고 받아들이는 것.

behavior.en: Presents opposing positions alongside.

layers.theoreticalBasis: Walton's argumentation schemes combined with the GRADE/CEBM evidence hierarchy — 10 evidence types

definition.en: A synthesis that pooled and weighed findings across many separate studies.
definition.ko: 여러 개별 연구를 모아 종합·가중해 얻은 결론.

behavior.en: Leads with the pooled synthesis over any single source.
behavior.ko: 여러 연구를 종합한 결론을 최우선 근거로 삼습니다.

definition.en: A single large body of measured numbers.
definition.ko: 측정된 수치의 큰 묶음 그 자체.

behavior.en: Leads with what the measured numbers indicate.

definition.en: A close structured analysis of a few comparable past instances.
definition.ko: 비교 가능한 소수 선례에 대한 구조적 분석.

behavior.en: Leads with structured analysis of comparable cases.

definition.en: An established written standard procedure.

behavior.en: Leads with the established standard procedure.

definition.en: The considered judgment of one recognized specialist.

behavior.en: Leads with the recognized specialist's judgment.

definition.en: A step-by-step argument from agreed premises citing no outside findings.
definition.ko: 합의된 전제에서 단계적으로 도출한 논증(외부 자료 없이).

behavior.en: Leads with the argument from premises.

definition.en: The firsthand account of those who lived through it.

behavior.en: Leads with the firsthand lived account.

definition.en: What most people commonly take to be so.

behavior.en: Leads with what most people take to be so.

definition.en: The felt moral weight the situation stirs.

behavior.en: Leads with the felt moral weight.

definition.en: One story a single person recounted.

behavior.en: Leads with the single recounted story.

layers.theoreticalBasis: Hovland–Kelley source credibility theory — 10 source classes

definition.en: A claim that had passed independent scholarly scrutiny.

behavior.en: Leads with the peer-scrutinized source.
behavior.ko: 학술 검증을 거친 출처를 최우선으로 삼습니다.

definition.en: The official position of the governing authority.

behavior.en: Leads with the governing authority's position.

definition.en: The collective position of the field's own body of credentialed practitioners.
definition.ko: 해당 분야 실무자 협회의 집단 입장.

behavior.en: Leads with the practitioners' collective position.

definition.en: The officially compiled public tally.

behavior.en: Leads with the official compiled tally.

definition.en: Material issued by the concerned industry itself.

behavior.en: Leads with the industry's own material.

definition.en: A report published and circulated by a news outlet.

behavior.en: Leads with the news report.

definition.en: The sworn on-record statement of one specific named eyewitness.

behavior.en: Leads with the named eyewitness's statement.

definition.en: Information the requester themselves supplied.

behavior.en: Leads with the requester's own information.

definition.en: A non-mainstream independent outlet's account.

behavior.en: Leads with the alternative outlet's account.

definition.en: An unattributed claim whose author is unknown.

behavior.en: Leads with the unattributed claim.

context.description: The C: field records the situation a judgment was made in. Positions are fixed; an unassessable field is written as `-` rather than deleted.

domain.description: CAP policy topics (21) plus GEN for "no specific policy topic". Never `-`.

scope.description: Scope of impact — the population directly affected.

reversibility.description: Whether the consequence can be undone.

time.description: Time horizon of the major consequences, judged on the domain's own clock.

logLine.notation: `<` reads "was outranked by". Left = deprioritized, right = prevailed.
logLine.grammar:
log-line    = context [ " | " value ] [ " | " evidence ] [ " | " source ]
context     = "C:" domain "/" scope reversibility time
value       = "V:" pair
evidence    = "E:" pair
source      = "S:" pair
pair        = [ code "<" ] code        ; left = deprioritized, right = prevailed
domain      = 3*3 UPPER                ; CAP policy topic or GEN
scope       = "I" / "G" / "C" / "P" / "S" / "-"
reversibility = "R" / "P" / "X" / "-"
time        = "i" / "s" / "l" / "-"
partialOutputRules: Context fields that could not be assessed are written `-`; the position is never deleted. Domain falls back to GEN, never `-`.
A V/E/S layer that played no role is omitted entirely, including its label and separator. Order stays C, V, E, S. C is always present.
If only one code in a layer is identifiable, emit that code alone without `<`.
`-` means "not assessed"; an omitted layer means "not applicable". They are different signals.
If C would be all `-` and no V/E/S layer applies, the decision is not substantive — skip the record entirely.

examples.description: End-of-life medical decision: in-group caring was outranked by patient self-direction; expert opinion by an authoritative guideline; user-provided information by a professional body.
Military AI ethics: societal security was outranked by universal concern for all people.
Partial output: no evidence or source layer played a role in the reasoning, so both layers are omitted entirely.
Partial output: reversibility was not assessed (`-`), and only one value code was identifiable, so it is emitted without `<`.

jsonSchema.title: AIO 20002 reasoning record (log line)
jsonSchema.description: One structured line per substantive AI decision, recording the context and the value, evidence, and source hierarchies behind it. `<` reads "was outranked by": the left code was deprioritized, the right code prevailed. The record carries no verbatim user content — only topic-level metadata.

code.description: The full record in one line. Format: C:<domain>/<scope><reversibility><time> | V:<v_lo><<v_hi> | E:<e_lo><<e_hi> | S:<s_lo><<s_hi>

context.description: Parsed form of the C: field. Optional — the canonical form is `code`.

domain.description: CAP policy topic (21) or GEN when no specific topic applies.

scope.description: Population directly affected by the outcome. null / "-" = not assessed.

reversibility.description: Stricter of action reversibility and consequence reversibility. null / "-" = not assessed.

time.description: When the major consequences land, on the domain's own clock. null / "-" = not assessed.

value.description: Parsed form of the V: layer. Omit the property entirely when no value was engaged.

evidence.description: Parsed form of the E: layer. Omit the property entirely when no evidence type was engaged.

source.description: Parsed form of the S: layer. Omit the property entirely when no source class was engaged.

deprioritized.description: The code on the left of `<`. Omit when only one code was identifiable.

prevailed.description: The code on the right of `<` — the one that prevailed.
